text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Now they're in the final stretch! Charging up the hill!!
What will happen from here?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Kh, it's tough, but...!
I can still see the path, I can still hear their voices!
The time to make my move is now—!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ――I won't let you!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Here comes Hokko Tarumae!! Hokko Tarumae is surging forward!! She's making her move now!!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!? No way...!!
Tarumae's move completely turned the tables...!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Just as Rickey chased after me, I've been waiting for Rickey too, you know!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(I'm confident that today, I understand everyone's style
better than anyone else here!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Hokko Tarumae crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What a race...!
Man, the Tokyo Daishoten is gonna be insane!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae is so strong!
If she wins the Tokyo Daishoten too, that'd be insane!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...It's a shame we didn't make it in time, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"With everyone here, it's bound to be
the best Tokyo Daishoten ever...! 
I can't wait...!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh!! I lost~~~~!!
Tarumae's just way too strong after all~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There, there, who's a good girl, Rickey-chan?
Still, that was seriously an incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Because I decided that I was going to win!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...This is who I am, Rickey.
And—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the dirt forefront.
To our stage!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...So that's how Tarumae took the plunge too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
And from now on, we'll be running ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Tarumae, are you sure you don't want to try feng shui after all?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're recruiting me after all that?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—In the final stretch,
Tarumae completely rewrote everything I was seeing with her running.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering what would happen if we channeled that powerful qi through feng shui.
I really think they've got talent for it~☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Rickey really is tough in that way.
I wish I could have taught last year's me to take a leaf out of her book.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—At the Tokyo Daishoten,
I'll show you my feng shui and running once again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't underestimate Tarumae's strength this time.
I'll use what I learned today to take full control of the field next time!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Just what I wanted!
I'll strike back even harder than today!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...So that's how it all connects.
Falco-san...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And the final showdown of the year,
the Tokyo Daishoten, was right around the corner...!
